answer: Farming becomes a kernel bet on surviving 54 epochs of grading, and every timber settlement recomputes the delta schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 54 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 36 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
